title.en: Climate change, floods, droughts and cyclones

text.en:
Raju's village had a flood one year and a drought the next.
"The weather is more extreme now," said his grandfather.

Climate is the average weather of a place over many years. Climate affects farming, clothes, homes and health. Heavy rain can cause floods, too little rain causes drought, and cyclones hit coasts.
Climate change means the climate is slowly shifting, largely because burning fuels adds gases that trap heat. The Earth is getting warmer and sea levels are rising.
We can help by saving energy, planting trees and using public transport.
